Proposed next action: test one owner-and-next-action check on the next eight personal practice cases, for Alex only.

Working plan

For the next eight cases, record both fields during intake review. Where either remains unresolved, record the reason, an explicit confirmation step and the responsible person to confirm; do not invent an assignment. At review, compare the missing-either count with the baseline 4/8. Capture elapsed review time separately if you want to investigate time savings. These small personal samples are descriptive, not representative; neither time savings nor a causal effect is established. Confirm whether the source's review date, 2026-11-06, should be used.

Case ID | Owner | Next action | Unresolved reason | Responsible person to confirm | Review date/status
